subject: MSA redline + vendor demo — role alignment and time options
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Wells <sarah.wells@helioshealth.com>; procurement@helioshealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: MSA redline + vendor demo — role alignment and time options

Hi Sarah / Helios procurement team,

Thanks for engaging—we'd like to combine a short MSA redline review with a product demo so legal and technical folks have the same context. Draft agenda attached (redline + demo). Proposed approaches:

- Option A: 75-minute joint session (20m legal review / 45m demo / 10m next steps)
- Option B: split into two back-to-back invites: 30m legal-only, 45m demo (separate invites)

Can you confirm which you prefer and share 2–3 windows next week in PDT? We'll bring our counsel (Marissa) and a PM to demo. Also, let me know who will drive the redline tracker on your side (procurement or legal).

Attachments: redline-demo-agenda.pdf

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Sarah Wells <sarah.wells@helioshealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@helioshealth.com; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redline + vendor demo — role alignment and time options

Alex — thanks for the clear options and the agenda. We'll do split sessions (Option B) to keep legal focused first. Our procurement lead will own the tracker and loop in Legal for material points.

Availability next week (PT):
- Tue 5/27: 10:00–12:00 ok (prefer morning)
- Wed 5/28: 13:00–16:00 ok
- Thu 5/29: limited (morning only)

Please send two calendar invites (legal 30m + demo 45m) and we will accept. Also can you share a short link to any outstanding redline items you expect to discuss?

Best,
Sarah Wells
Head of Procurement | Helios Health
sarah.wells@helioshealth.com | +1 212-555-0104

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Wells <sarah.wells@helioshealth.com>; procurement@helioshealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redline + vendor demo — role alignment and time options

Thanks Sarah — splitting makes sense. To streamline scheduling and avoid back-to-back confusion, would you be okay with a single 75-minute block on your calendar that we label with two agenda sections (legal first, then demo)? If not, we'll send two invites.

Quick note on the redline items: we've summarized the top 6 asks in this folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMSA-issues (read-only for your team). Major points are: data residency, audit log retention, and indemnity cap alignment.

If you're set on separate invites, we'll schedule:
- Legal (30m): review open redlines and action owners
- Demo (45m): product walkthrough focusing on data flows and access controls

Who on your legal team should be on the legal-only invite?

Alex
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Wells <sarah.wells@helioshealth.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redline + vendor demo — role alignment and time options

Hi all — Redwood will bring Marissa (legal) + Laura (Product PM) for the session. We prefer split invites to keep the legal discussion tight and allow engineers to skip the legal-only portion if unnecessary.

Sarah, can we lock Tue 5/27 for the legal 30m at 10:00–10:30 PT and the demo 10:35–11:20 PT (10-minute buffer between)? That fits your stated availability and gives us contiguous time on attendees' calendars. If that works for Helios, Alex — can you send both invites and include the agenda/docs and the HubSpot deal link? I'll prep the demo script focused on audit logs, KV caching, and private deployment control-plane separation.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Sarah Wells <sarah.wells@helioshealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@helioshealth.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redline + vendor demo — role alignment and time options

That schedule works — please send two invites (10:00 legal; 10:35 demo) and a combined agenda in each invite noting "legal-only" vs "technical demo" sections. Also attach our SOC2 summary (attached) on the demo invite for your reviewers.

One more ask: can you attach a draft SOW or a DocuSign route for the standard PO path so procurement can preview commercial terms before the call? If you can't, we can proceed without it but would like to see timeline expectations.

I'll accept once invites are in calendar.

Regards,
Sarah Wells
Head of Procurement | Helios Health

Attachments: helios-soc2-summary.pdf
